grain: one provider/game_id in the observed bounded prefix
classification: source opening family is the trimmed text before the first colon in the provider tag; no local position classifier
numerator: eligible games in selected source opening family
denominator: eligible games with a nonempty source opening family
eligible: rated Standard accepted games with completed result, excluding source-marked bots
null_rules: missing/empty source opening excluded from denominator and reported separately
caveats: The 100,000-game prefix is a convenience sample, not an August 2026 population sample.
Opening tags are provider supplied; opening choice is confounded.
